text:
eva: quick RFC follow-up re: probe-budget fairness and KV health. Proposal: intake issues a soft probe budget per-model driven by a cost score, prober enforces local caps and prioritizes golden prefixes. Trying to avoid bench storms and KV poisoning while keeping correctness gates untouched.

marin: sounds right. two clarifications: (1) how do we compute the cost score, (2) how do we guarantee low-priority models make progress during sustained rushes?

sam: cost_score = recent_ingest_qps * expected_token_cost * seqlen_multiplier. Expected_token_cost comes from registry profile or quick microbench. For progress guarantees, add a per-model linear ramp that ensures a minimum probe floor (eg min_probe_rps = base * min(1, t_since_ingest / ramp_window)).

yang: nice. that ramp prevents permanent starvation. Also propose per-customer soft_floor so a single tenant can't monopolize probes during a multi-tenant rush. fairness_weight = tenant_share_factor * priority_weight.

eva: prober details: maintain two LRU buckets for KV keys: golden and others. When kv_util > safe_threshold evict oldest from others. Also cap unique-prefix-inflight to N per-prober and enforce TTL-based decay.

marin: good. we must be explicit: deterministic checks (tokenizer parity, logits sanity) are scheduled before any perf probes and exempt from pacing so no correctness regressions.

sam: observability: record effective_probe_plan with the model artifact and emit a compact probe_plan blob to telemetry: {"budget_rps": "..","ramp_window_s": "..","priority_weight":".."} so downstream evals know sampling conditions.

yang: simulation: sam, can you run a hotspot trace: 150 models landing from 10 tenants in 8 minutes with mixed priorities and seqlen distributions? success criteria: (a) golden_coverage >= 0.8 in 30m for 90% models, (b) kv_miss_rate <5% system-wide, (c) low-priority median deepbench_start < 60m in rush.

sam: will run steady-state + hotspot. i'll add a fairness variant where tenant_share_factor is enforced and one where it's not so we can compare.

eva: ops note: dedicated pools with reservations must bypass global soft budget only if reserved_capacity >= requested_capacity. include "deployment_hint": "dedicated_override" with required_capacity param.

ops-bot: staging: probe-pacer v0.1 deployed to prebench queue (soft mode).

marin: action items: marin to update RFC with cost formula + min_probe_ramp, sam to produce sim traces and dashboards, yang to add tenant fairness hints in registry, eva to prototype prefix caps and TTL eviction. target: RFC v0.2 by Friday.

eva: thanks. post sim results here and attach the probe_plan sample for a few models so we can inspect recorded configs. :thumbsup:
